d:
Raju, a young man, is devoted to his stepmother as he only wishes to be showered with motherly love. However, his stepmother exploits his love to extort his wealth.
Beta is a 1992 Indian Hindi romantic drama film, directed by Indra Kumar and written by Naushir Khatau and Kamlesh Pandey.
The film Anil Kapoor, Madhuri Dixit and Aruna Irani in lead roles.
The soundtrack was composed by Anand-Milind.
The film is known for its songs like "Dhak Dhak Karne Laga" and "Koyal Si Teri Boli".
Movie - Beta (1992)
Director - Indra Kumar
Writers - Gyandev Agnihotri, Bhagyaraj, Rajeev Kaul
